verdict.rationale: dlt does not publish a formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec for its own API surface — explicit probes for openapi.json, swagger.json, etc. all returned 404 — but it does expose a machine-readable llms.txt documentation index (HTTP 200) that an AI-native consumer could parse as an 'equivalent' machine-readable resource. This is a much thinner artifact than a true API spec. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/JSON schema describing dlt's CLI/SDK/REST surface, independent confirmation that llms.txt is used as an API-spec substitute by agents.
